name: RAC 综合管理 — RAC 配置与管理综合
description: RAC 综合管理规则，覆盖 RAC 集群的日常管理操作：实例状态检查、资源管理、Service 配置、互联网络检查、存储配置验证。用作 RAC 环境的健康评估和管理操作参考。

conditions.desc: RAC 环境需要管理检查

root_causes.name: 实例状态异常
root_causes.desc: RAC 实例未正常启动或处于异常状态。

root_causes.name: 互联网络问题
root_causes.desc: RAC 私有互联网络延迟高或丢包，影响 Cache Fusion 性能。

root_causes.name: Service 配置不当
root_causes.desc: 数据库 Service 未正确配置 preferred/available 实例，负载不均。

root_causes.name: ASM 磁盘组配置问题
root_causes.desc: ASM 磁盘组冗余不足、空间告警或 rebalance 未完成。

step1_check_instances.desc: 检查所有 RAC 实例状态
step1_check_instances.sql: SELECT inst_id, instance_name, host_name, status, database_status, active_state, logins, shutdown_pending FROM GV$INSTANCE ORDER BY inst_id

step2_check_interconnect.desc: 检查 RAC 互联网络
step2_check_interconnect.sql: SELECT inst_id, name, ip_address, is_public FROM GV$CLUSTER_INTERCONNECTS ORDER BY inst_id

step3_check_services.desc: 检查 Service 配置和状态
step3_check_services.sql: SELECT inst_id, name, network_name, pdb FROM GV$ACTIVE_SERVICES WHERE name NOT LIKE 'SYS%' ORDER BY name, inst_id

step4_check_gc_performance.desc: 检查 Cache Fusion 性能
step4_check_gc_performance.sql: SELECT inst_id, event, total_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000,2) avg_ms FROM GV$SYSTEM_EVENT WHERE event LIKE 'gc%' AND total_waits > 0 ORDER BY time_waited_micro DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step5_check_asm.sql: SELECT group_number, name, state, type, total_mb, free_mb, ROUND(free_mb/total_mb*100,1) free_pct FROM v$asm_diskgroup ORDER BY name

step6_check_cluster_status.sql:
-- crsctl check cluster -all
-- crsctl stat res -t
SELECT 'Run crsctl commands for cluster status' AS action FROM dual
